༄༅/ /snyan rgyud las lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snyan rgyud las lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bzhugs so//

༄༅// gnyis pa dbang ni/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcing*// phyi dkyil gyi lho sgo nas g.yon bskor gyis shar khyams su zhugs pa// gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer gyis thugs kar bkug ste pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyi'i shar khyams su gzhag pa skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad kyi gzugs su gyur/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ tot+ta ka hūm̐/ mna' chu blud/ de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byaur ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs la dpal he ru ka bdag la phob cig /bla ma dang gtso bo gnyis su med pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phraus/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du zhugs pas lus mer zhu bar bsam/ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro ta a be sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid+yā ma hā bid+yā rā dza dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes dpa' bo bskul ba'i sngags bgrang*/ bdud rtsi lnga'i rdul gyis sbags pa'i bu mo'i 'doms dkris byi la'i brun gu gul bsres pa thod par bcug pa yi dgas kyi me la bsregs te bdug /rol mo'i sgra drag po bsgrags pas/ slob dpon nus pa che na de la dpal he ru ka dngos su 'bebs par 'gyur la/ gzhan du cha shas tsam mo// bdag gi rigs gang yin pa'i lha de la phog par gyur cig snyam pas/ pra tits+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes pas me tog gi 'phreng ba dor bas gang la phog pa lhag pa'i lhar brda' sprad/ pra tī gṛ h+na s+t+waṃ mi maṃ swā hā ma hā ba la/ zhes dngos grub kyi tshul lam lha des rjes su 'dzin par dgongs pas 'phreng ba slob ma'i spyi bor bcings par mos/

mig dar/ oṃ ne tra a pa ha tra pa tra laṃ hri/ bkrol/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyon ni rnal 'byor ma rigs gyur// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlob// ces brjod pas mngon sum du mthong bar blta'o// 'jug pa'o// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ mchod sbyin ji ltar bstsal ba ltar/ bdag kyang rab tu skyab pa'i phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag rtsol// rnam rgyal kyi bum pa dang slob ma swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rdo rje de las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin cing phyag rgya drug gis brgyan zhing dar dang rin po ches spras pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar sa bon de las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa cha gnyis gdan gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bum rdzas dang slob ma la ye shes pa thim/ bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu ba'i bum chur gyur// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyi rin po che'i bum pa dam tshig gi chus gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyi bgegs ring du skod par mdzad de/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams kun gyis khrus gsol ltar/ lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin chu'i rgyun kyis lus bkrus pas rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang chu'i khams nyon mongs pa gti mug /de'i dbang gis bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/

de bzhin slob ma dang cod pan traṃ las rin chen/ de las rdo rje nyi ma dmar po rin po che dang rin chen rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa cod pan dang slob ma la thim/ dbang rdzas kyi rin 'byung 'od du zhu ba cod pan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas/ rig pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i rin po che'i cod pan gyis dbang skur/ tsam las gzhan 'dra/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'i/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu brgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa ni ye hūm̐/ zhes bkon/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin cod pan gyis dbang bskur bas/ tshor ba'i phung po dang*/ nam mkha'i khams dang*/ nyon mong pa nga rgyal lo/ de'i dbang nas mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas// rdo rje dang slob ma hrīḥlas pad+ma de las snang ba mtha' yas mthing ka pad+ma dang pad+ma'i dril bu// thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// zhes rdo rje lags g.yas su sbyin// snang ba mtha' yas kyi rang bzhin rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas 'du shes kyi phung po dang*/ me'i khams/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ slob ma dang dril bu khaṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de las ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// g.yon du sbyin/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin dril bu'i dbang bskur bas 'du byed kyi phung po dang*/ rlung gi khams/ nyon mongs pa phrag dog /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de nas slob ma bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo de las rnam par snang mdzad ser po 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i dril bu 'dzin pa/

dpa' bo lag tu rdo rje dril// bzung ngo 'khor lo gsum bdag nyid// rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni// phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// des rdor dril bsnol thabs su bzung bcug /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta che ge mo badz+ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mī swā hā/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin ming gi dbang bskur bas/ gzugs kyi phung po dang sa'i khams// nyon mongs pa gti mug /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phraing ba byung*/ zhal nas thon slob ma 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs te snying ga'i sa bon dang sngags kyi 'phreng ba la ṛm pa bzhin thim pa'i mos pa gyis byas la yab yum gyi snying po nye snying rtsa ba'i sngags sam 'phreng ba'i sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ rdo rje dang me tog spyi bor bkod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po yi ni ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyi kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// zhes sngags dbang bskur// rdo rje gtad/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka yi brtul zhugs bstan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ /tiṣ+ṭha e ka ya s+t+waṃ dha ra ya mi oṃ ha ha ha hi/ rdo rje'i brtul bzhugs /de nas kha twaṃ thod pa cang te'u phyag rgya drug sbyin nas/ sna tshogs bsam pa'i bye brag gis// gang gis spyod pa rnam dag pa// 'dod la thugs rje'i gtso bo yis// sems can don ni byed pa'i thabs// nga yis spyod pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin// lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi sna ri dgas kyi rna ba ltar byas te bzung g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pas/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod// rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// shrī he ru ka ḍā ki nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur bhu waḥswaḥlung bstan/

khams gsum chos kyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*// de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsaul// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni de ring mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma seṅge'i khri la bkod/ gdugs phub/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum du bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab go bskon snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phraus/ 'khor lau sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs spyan drangs/ rdo rje sems dpa' dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum lngas rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa he ru ka'i rang bzhin gyi chus dbang bskur/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ sgo mtshams kyi khro mo rnams kyis gegs skrod pa'i bya ba mdzad bzhin pas/ rdo rje chen pos dbang bskur ba// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// zhes rnam rgyal gyi bum pa spyi bor bkod// bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i rgyun lud pa spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs lus kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed ṛm bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan du gyur// lha tshogs thams cad de dang gnyis su maid par th-im pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen paur gyur par bsams te/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ de la sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas mchod par bya'o// de nas/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mi bya ba ni cung zad med// de nyid shes pa de nas ni// dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyod do// bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos// bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi dngos// de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya// bdag nyid he ru ka mchod bya// rten cing 'brel par 'byung chos can// sems can rgyu yi rang bzhin no// khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/

sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas/ skyob pa med pa rnams kyi skyabs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ni/ ltos med thugs rje chen po yis// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon mdzod cig /kye ho mgon gtso khyed rnams kyis// theg chen ting 'dzin ji lta ba// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// de nas gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas yab yum gyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad la khyab pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi lha thams cad gsang gnas su 'dus rdo rje'i lam dang ze ba nas bha gar babs pa gsang ba de nas lce thog tu sbyin par mos te/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin byang chub sems rgyun gyis// de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes khas a ho ma hā su kha zhes myang ngo*// de nas bla mas/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba// khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len// bde ba chen pos myang bar gyis// zhes dam tshig phog /des ngag gi dri ma dag /lam rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// gsang dbang ngo*// de nas maṇ+ḍal dang*// sngar bzhin gsaul ba btab// slob ma gtso bor bskyed// phyag rgya rdo rje phag mo/ de'i lag pa nas bla mas bzung ste/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ bde ba mtha' yas ster byed ma// blangs nas bu yis dus kun tu// bla na med pa'i mchod pa gyis// zhes gtad// phyag rgya des/ dpa' bo bu khyod ci la spro// byang chub sems ni bza' ba dang*// rigs lnga las ni rab tu byung*/ rig ma gus pas yang dag mchod// gshang gci stobs dang dri chen sogs// de ni so sor bza' ba dang*// gzhan yang mdzes pa'i dam tsh-ig rnams// ji ltar sprau ba bu yis smros// zhes dri ba la/

ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams// lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba'i phyir// pad+ma rtag tu cis mi mchod// de nas de rang gi bha ga rgyas pa lag gis phye ste bhañdza mo k+ṣa ho zhes brjod cing*/ de'i nang gi rtsa sor mos bskul te/ mkha' hrīḥlas pad+ma dang*/ ze'u 'bru aḥmatshan pa/ rtags hūm̐ las rdo rje dang nor bu oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ phaṭ kyis gnyis ka'i thig le rgyu ba'i bu ga bkag par bsams te/ snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du bya'o/ des dbang gsum pa thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag /pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// bla mas/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// mi 'dra sems can thams cad kyi// don gyi bdag nyid kun gyis shig /gsum pa'o// de nas khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bkrin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bkrin gyis ni bskyang du gsol// gsol ba gdab// sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa ni// e waṃ rnam par rab tu gnas// sku dang gsum dang thugs kyi las// rnam kun mchog gi sdom pa'o// sdom pa byang chub bde mchog ste// ltar med brjod du med pa'o// zhes tshig gis brda sprad pa bzhi pa'o// dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes shes kyi dri ma dag phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*// 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'o// de nas/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes pa ste// bskyed pa'i ṛm pa'i bsgom pa yi// man ngag las ni 'di mi shes// rig pa 'di ni dor byas nas// thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod// rig ma'i brtul zhugs so// de nas yon phul dga' ba brjod par bya'o// deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// zhes so// sta dgon dang 'jug pa dkyil 'khor rgyas pas kha bskang nas// bcu gsum ma'i dbang bsdus par yang 'gyur ro// zhes pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba'o/// /
